gloss: yen coin (used after a denomination, e.g. 100{円玉|えんだま} "100-yen coin")

definitions.gloss: yen coin; coin of a given yen denomination
definitions.explanation: A noun used to refer to a yen coin of a specified value. Almost always preceded by a numeric denomination — the standard ones are {一円玉|いちえんだま} (¥1), {五円玉|ごえんだま} (¥5), {十円玉|じゅうえんだま} (¥10), {五十円玉|ごじゅうえんだま} (¥50), {百円玉|ひゃくえんだま} (¥100), and {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま} (¥500). On its own, {円玉|えんだま} just means "yen coin" generically, in contrast to お{札|さつ} ("bills").

examples.japanese: ⟦{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}→百円玉：28167_hyakuendama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have one 500-yen coin in my wallet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十円玉|じゅうえんだま}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The vending machine accepts 10-yen coins, too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、{何年分|なんねんぶん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一円玉|いちえんだま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{五円玉|ごえんだま}→五円玉：29055_goendama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I opened the desk drawer, years' worth of 1-yen and 5-yen coins came tumbling out.

notes:
{円玉|えんだま} is a compound of ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ ("yen") and {玉|だま}/⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ ("ball, round object," a suffix used for round small objects including coins). It denotes a yen coin and is essentially always preceded by a numeric denomination, although in contrastive contexts it can stand alone (e.g. {円玉|えんだま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧, "coins and bills").

FORMS:
- {一円玉|いちえんだま}: 1-yen coin (aluminum)
- ⟦{五円玉|ごえんだま}→五円玉：29055_goendama⟧: 5-yen coin (brass, with center hole)
- {十円玉|じゅうえんだま}: 10-yen coin (bronze)
- {五十円玉|ごじゅうえんだま}: 50-yen coin (cupronickel, with center hole)
- ⟦{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}→百円玉：28167_hyakuendama⟧: 100-yen coin (cupronickel)
- {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}: 500-yen coin (the largest in everyday circulation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}→百円玉：28167_hyakuendama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to insert a 100-yen coin (e.g., into a vending machine)
- {五百円玉|ごひゃくえんだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧: to save up 500-yen coins (a popular saving habit)
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{円玉|えんだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to separate coins from bills

COUNTER:
- The counter for coins as physical objects is ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ when speaking of an individual coin: ⟦{百円玉|ひゃくえんだま}→百円玉：28167_hyakuendama⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧ ("one 100-yen coin"). In casual speech, ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ also occurs.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧: small change / coins (collective)
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: coin (the formal/written term, used in laws and bank language)
- ⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧ / ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧: paper bills
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ / {玉|だま}: ball, round object (used in many other compounds: ⟦{目玉|めだま}→目玉：13649_medama⟧ "eyeball," ⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧ "water drop / polka dot")

USAGE:
- The reading is rendaku-shifted: ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ → だま after another element ({百円|ひゃくえん} + ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ → ひゃくえんだま).
- {円玉|えんだま} is used in everyday speech; in formal writing, banking, and legal contexts, the coin is referred to as ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧ (e.g., {百円硬貨|ひゃくえんこうか}).
